chapterInfo.content:
22
Nkwa asubɔnten ne nkwa dua no
1 # Hes 47.1; Sak 14.8 Na ɔkyerɛɛ me nkwa nsuo asubɔnten a ani teɛ sɛ ahwehwɛ a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no ahennwa no mu 2#Adi 21.21; Hes 47.12 ne kuro no abɔntene mfimfini. Asubɔntene no afanu nyinaa na nkwa dua a ɛso aba ahodoɔ dummienu sisie, na ɛsoso n’aba bosome biara. Na dua no ahahan na wɔde sa amanaman no yadeɛ.
3 # Sak 14.11 Na mmusuo biara nni hɔ bio; na Onyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no ahennwa no na ɛbɛsi mu, na ne nkoa bɛsom no, 4#Adi 21.3; 3.12 na wɔbɛhunu n’anim, na ne din bɛba wɔn moma so. 5#Adi 21.25; 5.10; Dan 7.18; 7.27 Na anadwo nni hɔ, na kanea anaa owia hann nhia wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade Nyankopɔn bɛhyerɛn wɔn so. Na wɔbɛdi ahene daa daa.
6 # Num 27.16; 1 Ko 14.32; Adi 1.1 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsɛm yi wɔ mu, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ, na Awurade, adiyifoɔ ahonhom Nyankopɔn no, asoma ne bɔfoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛkyerɛ ne nkoa adeɛ a ɛtwa sɛ ɛba ntɛm. 7#Adi 22.12; 22.20; 3.11; 1.3 Na hwɛ, mereba ntɛm. Nhyira ne deɛ ɔkura nwoma yi mu adiyisɛm mu.
8 # Adi 19.10 Na me, Yohane, ne deɛ ɔhunuu nnoɔma yi na ɔteeɛ. Na meteeɛ na mehunuiɛ no, mehwee ase sɛ merekoto asɔre ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkyerɛɛ me nnoɔma yi nan ase. 9Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, nyɛ saa, meyɛ wo ne wo nuanom adiyifoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔkura nwoma yi mu nsɛm mu no awurakwaa. Koto sɔre Onyankopɔn!
10 # Adi 10.4; Dan 8.26; 12.4; Adi 1.3 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsɔ nwoma yi mu adiyisɛm ano, na ɛberɛ no abɛn. 11Deɛ ɔntene no nntene ara, na deɛ ɔyɛ fi no nyɛ fi ara. Na deɛ ɔtene no ntene ara, na deɛ ɔyɛ kronkron no nyɛ kronkron ara.
12 # Adi 22.7; 3.11; Yes 40.10; Rom 2.6 Hwɛ, mereba ntɛm, na mekura m’akatua sɛ mede merebɛma obiara sɛdeɛ n’adwuma teɛ. 13#Adi 1.11; Heb 13.8 Mene Alfa ne Omega, ɔkannifoɔ ne okyidifoɔ, mfitiaseɛ ne awieeɛ no. 14#Adi 7.14 Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔhoro wɔn ntadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔbɛnya nkwa dua no ho kwan, na wɔafa apono no ano akɔ kuro no mu. 15#Adi 21.8; 21.27; 1 Ko 6.9-10 Na kuro no akyiri na akraman ne adutofoɔ ne nnwamammɔfoɔ ne awudifoɔ ne abosonsomfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔpɛ atorɔ na wɔdie nyinaa wɔ.
16 # Adi 1.1; 1.2; Yes 11.10; Adi 5.5; Luka 1.78 Me, Yesu, na masoma me bɔfoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛdi mo nnoɔma yi ho adanseɛ asafo no mu. Mene Dawid nhini ne n’aseni, adekyeeɛ nsoromma a ɛhran no.
17 # Rom 8.23; Adi 21.6; Yes 55.1; Yoh 7.37 Na honhom no ne ayeforɔ no se: Bra!
Na deɛ ɔtie no nka sɛ: Bra!
Na deɛ sukɔm de no mmra,
na deɛ ɔpɛ no mmɛgye nkwa nsuo no kwa.
18 # Adi 15.1; 15.6 Mebɔ obiara a ɔte nwoma yi mu adiyie nsɛm no kɔkɔ sɛ: Sɛ obi de biribi ka nnoɔma yi ho a, Onyankopɔn de ɔhaw ahodoɔ a wɔatwerɛ wɔ nwoma yi mu no bɛka no ho. 19#Deut 4.2 Na sɛ obi yi adiyie nwoma yi mu nsɛm bi a, Onyankopɔn bɛyi ne kyɛfa afiri nkwa dua ne kuro kronkron a wɔatwerɛ ho nsɛm nwoma yi mu no mu.
20Deɛ ɔdi nnoɔma yi ho adanseɛ no se: Aane, mereba ntɛm.
Amen. Awurade Yesu, bra!
21Yɛn Awurade Yesu adom nka mo nyinaa. [Amen.]

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɔkyerɛɛ me nkwa nsuo asubɔnten a ani teɛ sɛ ahwehwɛ a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no ahennwa no mu ne kuro no abɔntene mfimfini. Asubɔntene no afanu nyinaa na nkwa dua a ɛso aba ahodoɔ dummienu sisie, na ɛsoso n’aba bosome biara. Na dua no ahahan na wɔde sa amanaman no yadeɛ.
Na mmusuo biara nni hɔ bio; na Onyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no ahennwa no na ɛbɛsi mu, na ne nkoa bɛsom no, na wɔbɛhunu n’anim, na ne din bɛba wɔn moma so. Na anadwo nni hɔ, na kanea anaa owia hann nhia wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade Nyankopɔn bɛhyerɛn wɔn so. Na wɔbɛdi ahene daa daa.
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsɛm yi wɔ mu, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ, na Awurade, adiyifoɔ ahonhom Nyankopɔn no, asoma ne bɔfoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛkyerɛ ne nkoa adeɛ a ɛtwa sɛ ɛba ntɛm. Na hwɛ, mereba ntɛm. Nhyira ne deɛ ɔkura nwoma yi mu adiyisɛm mu.
Na me, Yohane, ne deɛ ɔhunuu nnoɔma yi na ɔteeɛ. Na meteeɛ na mehunuiɛ no, mehwee ase sɛ merekoto asɔre ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔkyerɛɛ me nnoɔma yi nan ase. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hwɛ, nyɛ saa, meyɛ wo ne wo nuanom adiyifoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔkura nwoma yi mu nsɛm mu no awurakwaa. Koto sɔre Onyankopɔn!
Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Nsɔ nwoma yi mu adiyisɛm ano, na ɛberɛ no abɛn. Deɛ ɔntene no nntene ara, na deɛ ɔyɛ fi no nyɛ fi ara. Na deɛ ɔtene no ntene ara, na deɛ ɔyɛ kronkron no nyɛ kronkron ara.
Hwɛ, mereba ntɛm, na mekura m’akatua sɛ mede merebɛma obiara sɛdeɛ n’adwuma teɛ. Mene Alfa ne Omega, ɔkannifoɔ ne okyidifoɔ, mfitiaseɛ ne awieeɛ no. Nhyira ne wɔn a wɔhoro wɔn ntadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔbɛnya nkwa dua no ho kwan, na wɔafa apono no ano akɔ kuro no mu. Na kuro no akyiri na akraman ne adutofoɔ ne nnwamammɔfoɔ ne awudifoɔ ne abosonsomfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔpɛ atorɔ na wɔdie nyinaa wɔ.
Me, Yesu, na masoma me bɔfoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛdi mo nnoɔma yi ho adanseɛ asafo no mu. Mene Dawid nhini ne n’aseni, adekyeeɛ nsoromma a ɛhran no.
Na honhom no ne ayeforɔ no se: Bra!
Na deɛ ɔtie no nka sɛ: Bra!
Na deɛ sukɔm de no mmra,
na deɛ ɔpɛ no mmɛgye nkwa nsuo no kwa.
Mebɔ obiara a ɔte nwoma yi mu adiyie nsɛm no kɔkɔ sɛ: Sɛ obi de biribi ka nnoɔma yi ho a, Onyankopɔn de ɔhaw ahodoɔ a wɔatwerɛ wɔ nwoma yi mu no bɛka no ho. Na sɛ obi yi adiyie nwoma yi mu nsɛm bi a, Onyankopɔn bɛyi ne kyɛfa afiri nkwa dua ne kuro kronkron a wɔatwerɛ ho nsɛm nwoma yi mu no mu.
Deɛ ɔdi nnoɔma yi ho adanseɛ no se: Aane, mereba ntɛm.
Amen. Awurade Yesu, bra!
Yɛn Awurade Yesu adom nka mo nyinaa. [Amen.]

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
